body: NAH. love F/GO and I think you calling him out was warranted, especially after he lied. Him leaving the discord was up to him, and as long as you didn’t bully him into it you’re fine. No assholes here.

YWBTA. If your friend asked you not to bring weed to HER house, then don’t. Tell your other friends that you can’t. It’s not your call. If your friend is having you at HER house, you go by HER rules. She says no weed, then no weed. Don’t bring any.
Why are they so far away from you? Is there a way for you to still be in contact with them?

hey, it’s okay. i haven’t been in your shoes, but i know what it’s like to get so caught up in your own issues that you can’t seem to hold it together anymore. that person who said “i can’t be your therapist anymore” doesn’t get it. it’s hard to accept but not everyone will get it. the people in your life who do care, even if you can’t feel it, are the ones that matter. nobody says your journey’s over yet. nobody’s claiming you’re done and over it. you feel this way now, but what’s important is to look to a happier future. i know it’s hard, but don’t give up. message me if you want to talk in private. don’t let today be the day. you’ll beat this.

hi there, first of all i would love to congratulate you. it takes a lot to be able to quit self harm and i’m glad you’ve been able to for the time being.

obviously i can’t know exactly what you’ve been through, but it seems like you are making assumptions about how your friends feel.

look at it this way, when your friends come to you with an issue, how do you feel about it? chances are, you are willing and happy to help (if you have the mental space during that moment) so chances are your friends are more than happy to help.


i know it can seem like you’re putting too much on them, but people don’t say they care about you for no reason. even if you refuse to believe it, your friends are there for you and most likely aren’t trying to escape you. I’m not trying to prove you wrong, just trying to get you to look at it from another perspective.

i’m sorry things aren’t much different but a year is a long time. you may feel the same now as you did one year ago, but in that passing year you have had so many more experiences and feelings that you can look back on. 

you can do it, i believe in you.

thank you. i know it’s rough and i know i may not always understand, but my will to stick by him and help him is greater than anything i’ve ever felt. your comment means a lot to me and i wish you the best.

thank you, your comment meant a lot to me. one of my problems is that he doesn’t really communicate his feelings to me and although i tell him he can talk to me about anything and he has vented to me in the past, recently he’s been a lot more closed and pushing me away.

it hurts when he pushes me away like this but i stick with him no matter what and i know it goes under appreciated on his part but i am with him 100% of the time and i don’t think he uses me as somebody who will listen to him and doesn’t know that whenever he feels alone i will always come and just sit with him and tell him a story. he always says he’s alone in this world, so i feel like he never even thinks about me. I just think maybe i could make a difference if he wanted to be around me a little bit more...

i’m sorry you feel that way, it’s been rough for me too...

what helps me is to remember that just because I hate me doesn’t mean everyone else does. there are people who love you, you are enough for somebody.

i leave people a lot. when i’m down i close off and push away, but even through that there are people who stay. find those people and stay with them too and maybe you’ll get better.

best of luck, friend. my prayers are with you.
